metadata.title: opslsy_ticket_transition
metadata.description: HTTP-triggered Logic App building block that performs at most one direct Jira transition for an OPSLSY change ticket. It validates ticket scope (project + issue type), validates a unique destination-status match against transition.to.name, validates required transition fields against both request fields and existing issue values, submits the transition without retries, and verifies resulting status within a bounded synchronous window.
prerequisites: Key Vault secret '<JiraKeyVaultSecretName>' holding the Trackspace service account password.
KeyVault API connection (this template creates it if absent).
metadata.author: opslsy_ticket_transition

metadata.description: Name of the Consumption Logic App. Pass it explicitly on deploy so redeploys update this instance.
Azure region of the playbook and its Key Vault API connection.
Key Vault holding the Trackspace service-account password.
Trackspace base URL. Production is https://trackspace.lhsystems.com; use https://int-trackspace.lhsystems.com for INT.
Key Vault secret name storing the Trackspace password.
Jira project key this transition endpoint is allowed to mutate.
Allowed Jira issue type names for this transition endpoint (case-insensitive exact match after trim).
Maximum verification polling iterations after transition submission.
Overall timeout for synchronous status verification polling.

ticket_key.description: Jira key of the OPSLSY change ticket to transition.

target_status.description: Destination Jira status name (matched case-insensitively, whitespace-trimmed, exact equality to transition.to.name).

fields.description: Optional Jira transition fields. Keys must be Jira field ids/names accepted by the selected transition.

Compose_Validation_Errors.inputs: @union(if(empty(outputs('Compose_Request')?['ticket_key']), array('ticket_key is required.'), json('[]')), if(empty(outputs('Compose_Request')?['target_status']), array('target_status is required.'), json('[]')))

body.error: @{concat('Ticket is out of scope. Expected project ', parameters('JiraProjectKey'), ' and issue type in [', join(parameters('AllowedIssueTypes'), ', '), '], got project ', trim(string(coalesce(body('Parse_Ticket')?['fields']?['project']?['key'], 'unknown'))), ' and issue type ', trim(string(coalesce(body('Parse_Ticket')?['fields']?['issuetype']?['name'], 'unknown'))), '.')}

runError.message: Ticket is outside configured project/type scope.

body.error: @{concat('Expected exactly one direct transition to status ', outputs('Compose_Request')?['target_status'], ', found ', string(length(body('Filter_Matching_Transitions'))), '.')}

runError.message: Expected exactly one direct transition match.

body.error: @{concat('Required transition field(s) missing and not already present on the issue: ', join(variables('Missing_Required_Fields'), ', '), '.')}

@{concat('Transition submission may have happened but status verification did not reach ', outputs('Compose_Request')?['target_status'], ' within the synchronous polling window. Current status: ', outputs('Compose_Verification_Result')?['current_status'], '.')}

runError.message: Transition status could not be verified within the polling window.
